title: Data classification policy
content: Contoso Financial classifies information as Public, Internal, Confidential or Highly Confidential. Customer account data and credit decisions are Highly Confidential and may only be processed in private networks with encryption in transit and at rest. AI workloads that process Highly Confidential data must use private endpoints and must not call public internet tools.

title: Generative AI acceptable use
content: Employees may use approved generative AI services hosted in Contoso's Azure tenant. Prompts must not include passwords or secrets. Model outputs are advisory and must be reviewed by a human before being sent to customers. All AI interactions are logged for 30 days for audit purposes without storing prompt content in operational logs.

title: Remote access standard
content: Administrative access to cloud workloads is performed only through Azure Bastion to hardened jump hosts that have no public IP address. Sign-in requires Microsoft Entra ID with multifactor authentication and a compliant device. Direct RDP or SSH exposure to the internet is prohibited.

title: Expense reimbursement
content: Business travel expenses must be submitted within 30 days. Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 220 EUR per night in major European cities. Receipts are mandatory for all items above 25 EUR. Approval is required from the cost-center manager.

title: Incident response for data leakage
content: Suspected data leakage must be reported to the Security Operations Center within one hour. The SOC isolates affected identities, rotates credentials, reviews private endpoint and firewall logs, and notifies the Data Protection Officer within 24 hours if customer data is involved.

title: Model change management
content: Changing the model or model version used by a production AI application requires a change request, an evaluation run on the approved test set, and sign-off from the AI governance board. Model deployments use pinned versions and are upgraded only after the evaluation passes.

title: Working from abroad
content: Employees may work from another EU country for up to 30 days per year. Longer stays require approval from HR and Tax. Access to Highly Confidential systems from outside the EU is not permitted.

title: Network segmentation standard
content: Workloads are deployed into dedicated spoke virtual networks connected to the corporate hub. Each subnet has a network security group that denies inbound traffic by default. Internet egress is routed through the central firewall, which allows only approved destinations. Private DNS zones are managed centrally by the network team.
